summary: Backend-only verification of iter152 changes: Gemini generation-config split (precise: temp=0.0/top_p=0.1/top_k=1 for extraction/classification/PII/diarization; warm: temp=0.3 with default top_p/top_k for meeting summary regen, prep-questions gen, risk-suggestions gen) + CRITICAL SCAN MANDATE prompt block added to ANALYSIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT, DOC_EVIDENCE_SYSTEM_PROMPT, and analyze_custom_only inline prompt. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter152_warm_precise_config.py — 27/27 pass (21 static + mocked config kwarg checks, 6 live end-to-end calls). Static checks confirm: (a) CRITICAL SCAN MANDATE + 'Inventory Pass' + 'Multi-Standard Assignment' text present in all three evidence-scan system prompts; (b) `warm` param defaulted False on _openai_chat / _gemini_chat / _ai_chat / _ai_chat_json / _vertex_generate_sync; (c) warm=True passed ONLY at the 3 documented call sites (generate_meeting_summary, generate_prep_questions, generate_risk_suggestions); (d) 8 other AI helpers (analyze_meeting, analyze_doc_for_evidence, analyze_custom_only, scan_pii_in_transcript, diarize_transcript, map_speaker_numbers_to_names, extract_document_criteria, check_prep_coverage) do NOT pass warm=True. Mocked google.genai captures the actual GenerateContentConfig kwargs: warm=False path sets temperature=0.0 + top_p=0.1 + top_k=1; warm=True path sets temperature=0.3 and does NOT set top_p/top_k (leaves them at Gemini defaults). Live E2E on a realistic 1.7k-char supervision transcript: analyze_meeting served by gemini-2.5-flash in 55.1s, produced 47 cqc_mappings + 5 care_cert_mappings + 2 actions + 2 risks with valid likely_evidence/possible_evidence confidence values and ai_tracker fully populated (provider/fallback_used/latency_ms/fallback_reason=None). generate_meeting_summary returns >100-char bulleted summary using real attendee names ('Sarah'/'James'). generate_prep_questions returns multi-section structured questions with IDs. generate_risk_suggestions returns transcript_excerpt + non-empty suggested_resolutions. scan_pii_in_transcript on ~1.9k-char transcript flags expected names (Docherty/Patel/Whitehouse). GET /api/super-admin/ai-usage-report returns 200 with items whose ai_provider values are non-null and match known provider names. No regressions detected, all target functionality intact.
critical_code_review_comments: utils/ai.py::_vertex_generate_sync — the `warm` distinction is a boolean; if a future call site needs a different sampling profile (e.g. temp=0.1) this becomes a bool-explosion problem. Consider promoting `warm` to an enum or a small dataclass (SamplingProfile.PRECISE / .WARM / ...) before adding a third profile. Not urgent — 2 profiles is fine as-is.

utils/ai.py::_openai_chat — for warm=False the code sets temperature=0.0, but for some OpenAI reasoning models (o4-mini/o3) temperature is ignored/rejected. Verify the OpenAI fallback path doesn't 400 for o4-mini when temperature=0.0 is explicitly set (fallback wasn't exercised in this test run since Gemini served every call). If OpenAI rejects, wrap with a try/except that drops the param for reasoning models.

utils/ai.py::generate_risk_suggestions — falls back to gpt-4o (not o4-mini). If gpt-4o rejects temperature=0.3 in some future SDK bump, silent empty-response failure returns `{transcript_excerpt: '', suggested_resolutions: []}` with no user-visible error. Consider logging a distinct warning + reraising in dev.

CRITICAL SCAN MANDATE text is duplicated verbatim in 3 places (ANALYSIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT / DOC_EVIDENCE_SYSTEM_PROMPT / analyze_custom_only inline). DRY: extract as `_CRITICAL_SCAN_MANDATE` module-level constant and interpolate — otherwise the three copies will drift when future edits are made to one but not the others.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter152_warm_precise_config.py — 21 fast (0.9s) static/mocked tests guard against future regressions of the warm/precise split (call-site allow-list, param defaults, Vertex config kwargs). 6 live tests (~86s total) exercise real Gemini/OpenAI. If live Gemini quota is throttled, static tests alone still catch config drift. Live analyze_meeting on the 1.7k-char TRANSCRIPT fixture reliably produces 40+ mappings via Gemini — good regression signal for the mandate-driven exhaustive scan behaviour.
rca of the issue: N/A — validating a pre-diagnosed generation-config tuning change (not a bug fix). The user's diagnosis is well-supported by our live evidence: with temp=0.0/top_p=0.1/top_k=1 + high thinking budget + explicit 2-step scan mandate, a single analyze_meeting call on a short transcript now produces 47 CQC mappings — well beyond what a temp=0.3 sampled call would typically emit — with valid confidence values throughout. The warm-path calls (summary/prep/risk) still return natural-sounding conversational text at temp=0.3.
